description: Exact symbolic (ℚ(q)) derive-or-refute of whether the finite content-Casimir spectrum {μ_λ} is a q-Bessel/q-Lommel zero spectrum (lead-4 q-drumhead question). Verdict REFUTED for the finite per-n spectrum (compact SU_q(2) q-Casimir, algebraic, p(n)≠n), with the Bessel/Lommel structure redirected to the n→∞ brane-tower limit. docs/audits/2026-06-14-qbessel-lead4-mu-lambda-qlommel-derivation.md.
discipline: exact symbolic ℚ(q); no float; no fit; derive-or-refute; nothing wired
verdict: REFUTED (finite per-n spectrum), derived exactly in ℚ(q) — no float, no fit. The content-Casimir spectrum {μ_λ} is the COMPACT SU_q(2) q-Casimir (rational in q, finite of size p(n), quadratic-in-content; q→1 → the classical content-Casimir Σ c(c+1)). It cannot be a q-Bessel ZERO spectrum (those are infinite + transcendental over ℚ(q)); and it is not the degree-n q-Lommel zero set since p(n)≠n for n≥4. The q-Bessel/q-Lommel zero structure belongs to the NON-COMPACT E_q(2)/q-disk = the n→∞ brane-tower (contraction) limit, bridged to the compact spectrum only by the SU_q(2)→E_q(2) contraction (PR #2279). REDIRECT: the q-Lommel three-term recurrence is the right tool for the brane-TOWER (and the binding Δ_λ ladder), not the finite-n confinement spectrum. Confirms #2279/#2300 'the Bessel object is the tower, not the n-trace' from the spectral side. Nothing wired.
